migrationChecklist: Keep QR encoder, TensorFlow.js, MoveNet, TypeBox, and OpenCV.js license notices in the distributed bundle.
Keep QR courier pairing behind the startup-fixed default-OFF flag in config/feature-flags.ts.
Keep WebGPU MoveNet MultiPose behind its independent startup-fixed default-OFF flag.
Keep the protocol v1 codec behind its independent startup-fixed default-OFF flag.
Keep camera calibration behind its independent startup-fixed default-OFF flag and retain only exact v1 profiles.
Keep avatar retargeting behind its independent startup-fixed default-OFF flag and require A-Frame scene capability v1.
Keep exact-pinned Kalidokit as the sole avatar pose solver without a custom rotation fallback.
Keep OpenCV.js as the single exact-pinned production calibration backend without a reference solver.
Keep multi-camera 3D pose fusion behind its independent startup-fixed default-OFF flag.
Keep fusion limited to buffering, reordering, and resampling supplied timestamps; do not estimate per-camera clock offsets.
Validate every fused frame against the pinned PoseFrame3D v1 schema before retaining it.
Keep glow stick markers behind their independent startup-fixed default-OFF flag and sample colors only from the leased camera frame.
Own the application contracts here: src/protocol/schemas.ts is the source of truth and schemas/ holds its generated JSON Schemas.
Never take contract definitions from the application repository; applications depend on this package, never the reverse.
Reject unknown versions and pairing credentials in persistent contracts, and add a new contract version instead of editing a published one.
Treat pose timestamps as opaque values from an external synchronized time service; do not add clock probe, offset, ping, or pong logic.
Keep avatar retargeting free of frame alignment, history query, triangulation, and 3D solving; that work belongs to the fusion module behind its own flag.
Do not add CPU, WASM, or WebGL inference fallback or direct getUserMedia calls.
Run pnpm run check before publishing generated artifacts.
